params.1273: Drink a dose of attack potion.
params.1274: If you need an attack potion, you can make one by using a clean guam on a vial of water, and then using an eye of newt on the guam potion (Poletax can sell you these).
params.1275: Click on an <col=FFFFFF>attack potion</col> in your inventory to boost your Attack stat.
params.2225: The effects of a potion wear off slowly over time.
